title: Ashnikko Covers Gwen Stefani Hit on Triple J’s Like A Version
summary:
American singer Ashnikko has made her debut on triple j’s Like A Version, covering Gwen Stefani’s 2004 song “What You Waiting For?”

She performed in the triple j studio during her Australian tour with a full backing band that included a harpist. The electropop-leaning cover stayed close to Stefani’s original while adding Ashnikko’s own style. She also performed her own song “Sticky Fingers.”

Ashnikko called “What You Waiting For?” the song of her childhood and the track that inspired her to make music. She credited Stefani’s solo album Love. Angel. Music. Baby. as an early influence. In an interview with hosts Abby Butler and Tyrone Pynor, she also talked about bird watching and how important dance moves are to her shows.

Stefani’s song was the lead single from that 2004 album and reached No. 47 on the Billboard Hot 100. The album peaked at No. 7 on the Billboard 200 and included hits such as “Hollaback Girl” and “Rich Girl.” Stefani is also known as the frontwoman of No Doubt and has won four Grammy Awards.

Ashnikko broke through in 2019 with “Stupid,” a song that spread widely on TikTok, reached No. 90 on the Hot 100, and later earned a platinum certification. Her 2023 debut album Weedkiller charted on the Billboard 200. Like A Version is a long-running Australian radio segment known for memorable live covers.

The performance adds another chapter to Ashnikko’s mix of hyperpop, rap, and alternative sounds.
why_it_matters: Hearing how a modern artist remakes a childhood favorite shows how music influences travel across years. Live radio covers also introduce kids to performance as creative homage, not just copying.
